text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. This will go a long
way
toward brightening up the student
council office.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Look how well-made it is... It perfectly
captures
the Umamusume's most
distinctive features.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
This is making me curious to examine the
others...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should come back again by
myself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
